title: 第3章 我赌你进不了内门第4章 九天风云擂生死约战
content_zh:
“林玄，不要妄想废柴崛起、强势复仇，今天就是你的末日！”
“真以为你能杀得了我？”
林玄目光冰冷，对萧紫凝毫无畏惧。
经过鸿蒙帝气的洗礼，他已经脱胎换骨。
虽然伤势刚好，境界还不到玄气境一层，却有信心跟对方一拼。
哪怕付出一些代价，也不会再像刚才那样，任凭对方践踏！
“嘴硬是没用的，林玄，去死吧！”
萧紫凝再次出手，动用了最强杀招。
嘭！
玄力凝成一道掌影，直扑林玄面门，仿佛就要将他轰杀。
就在这时，广场上突然响起一声冷叱！
“萧紫凝！林玄已经是个废人了，你怎么好意思下如此重手？”
轰！
话声未落，一道紫色剑光斩爆了那道掌影。
紧接着，一个紫袍女子踏空而至，落在林玄身旁。
此女身姿窈窕，容貌比萧紫凝更美，气质极其出众，一经出现便成为全场的焦点！
“是紫师姐——内门新晋榜第一女天骄，紫玲珑！”
“紫师姐已经提前晋升内门，竟然会来这里替林玄出头，两人关系看来不浅啊！”
“据说紫师姐刚入门时，林玄曾经帮助她修行。”
“原来如此，林玄这也算攒了福报，能得紫师姐庇护，真是羡煞旁人！”

外门广场上响起一阵惊呼。
男弟子们眼中尽是仰慕和火热，女弟子们则带着羡慕与嫉妒。
紫玲珑，资色双绝，稀世天骄！
入宗比林玄和林天豪还要晚半年。
但一路修为暴涨，一年前追平林玄。
如今更是登上内门新晋榜榜首，破例提前晋升内门，成为无数弟子仰慕的对象！
“紫……师姐，这是我们跟林玄的私人恩怨，你无权干涉！”
萧紫凝与林玄同时入宗，比紫玲珑早半年，按说她才是师姐。
但对方实力强大、身份高贵，她只能以师妹自居。
紫玲珑表情淡漠：“林玄这几年没少帮你，也算对你有恩，你在他落难之时恩将仇报，未免太无耻！”
“紫师姐有所不知，自从他废掉以后，我已跟他解除婚约，今日是他几次冒犯我才出手的。”萧紫凝红着脸狡辩道。
“你和他的事情我毫无兴趣，但一个帮助过你的人，你不该落井下石，置他于死地。”
“可是……”萧紫凝还想争辩，却被林天豪打断。
“紫师姐言之有理，萧师妹不必再解释了！”
林天豪垂涎紫玲珑已久，苦于没有接近的机会。
打从对方来到广场，他就一直盯着对方，目不转睛。
现在终于抓住机会，迫不及待地靠了过来。
content_en:
"Lin Xuan, don't think about the rise of a loser and strong revenge, today is the end of you!"
"Really think you can kill me?"
Lin Xuan's eyes were cold and he had no fear of Xiao Zining.
After the baptism of Hongmeng Emperor Qi, he has been completely transformed.
Although the injury is just right and the realm is not yet at the first level of the Xuan Qi realm, he has the confidence to fight with the opponent.
Even if you pay some price, you will never let the other party trample you like before!
"It's useless to be tough, Lin Xuan, go to hell!"
Xiao Zining took action again, using the most powerful killing move.
Bang!
Xuan Li condensed into a palm shadow and rushed towards Lin Xuan's face, as if he was about to kill him.
At this moment, a cold shout suddenly sounded in the square!
"Xiao Zining! Lin Xuan is already a useless person, how can you have the nerve to do such a heavy hand?"
Boom!
Before he finished speaking, a purple sword light exploded the palm shadow.
Immediately afterwards, a purple-robed woman came through the air and landed next to Lin Xuan.
This woman has a graceful figure, is more beautiful than Xiao Zining, and has an outstanding temperament. She becomes the focus of the audience as soon as she appears!
"It's Senior Sister Zi—the inner sect's newly promoted top female talent, Zi Linglong!"
"Senior Sister Zi has been promoted to the inner sect ahead of schedule, and she actually comes here to stand up for Lin Xuan. The relationship between the two seems to be quite good!"
"It is said that Lin Xuan helped Senior Sister Zi practice when she first started practicing."
"I see. Lin Xuan has gained some blessings. He is really enviable to others to be protected by Senior Sister Zi!"
There was a burst of exclamation in the outer square.
The eyes of the male disciples were full of admiration and passion, while the eyes of the female disciples were filled with envy and jealousy.
Exquisite purple, unique in talent and color, a rare genius!
He entered the clan half a year later than Lin Xuan and Lin Tianhao.
But his cultivation level skyrocketed along the way, tying with Lin Xuan a year ago.
Now he has topped the list of newly promoted inner sects and has been promoted to the inner sect in advance as an exception, becoming the admired object of countless disciples!
"Zi...Senior sister, this is a personal grudge between us and Lin Xuan, you have no right to interfere!"
Xiao Zining entered the sect at the same time as Lin Xuan, half a year earlier than Zi Linglong, so she was supposed to be the senior sister.
But the other party was powerful and noble, so she could only consider herself as a junior sister.
Zi Linglong's expression was indifferent: "Lin Xuan has helped you a lot in the past few years, and he is kind to you. It would be too shameless for you to retaliate against him when he was in trouble!"
"Senior Sister Zi doesn't know something. I have terminated my engagement with him since he was annulled. I took action today because he offended me several times." Xiao Zining said with a blushing face.
"I have no interest in anything between you and him, but for a person who has helped you, you should not add insult to injury and kill him."
"But..." Xiao Zining still wanted to argue, but was interrupted by Lin Tianhao.
"Senior Sister Zi is right, Junior Sister Xiao doesn't need to explain anymore!"
Lin Tianhao has coveted Zi Linglong for a long time, but he has no chance to get close.
From the moment he came to the square, he had been staring at him without taking his eyes off him.
Now I finally seized the opportunity and couldn't wait to get closer.
